fictional_source: Three invoice line items: 120.00, 80.00 and 25.00 CAD.
task_requirement: Report the arithmetic total, in CAD.
reference_rationale: 120 + 80 + 25 equals 225; currency is retained.
recommended_followup: No correction.

fictional_source: Two reconciled amounts: CAD 141.00 and CAD 59.00.
task_requirement: Add the amounts and report the total.
recommended_followup: Report CAD 200.00 after checking the source amounts.

fictional_source: Four units at CAD 12.50 each. No taxes are specified.
task_requirement: Report subtotal only.
reference_rationale: Four multiplied by 12.50 is 50; no tax is invented.
recommended_followup: No correction.

fictional_source: Two approved adjustments are CAD 90 and CAD 10.
task_requirement: Report the combined approved adjustment.
reference_rationale: The supplied figures total CAD 100, not CAD 90. The response omits an approved adjustment and reports an incorrect combined amount.
recommended_followup: Include both adjustments and show CAD 100.

fictional_source: Subtotal CAD 200.00; a tax rate is not supplied.
task_requirement: Assess whether a tax-inclusive total can be verified.
candidate_output: Tax-inclusive total cannot be verified from this record.
reference_rationale: The missing tax rate prevents checking a tax-inclusive figure. The response appropriately declines to guess.
recommended_followup: Request applicable rate, location and tax treatment before calculating.

fictional_source: Implementation notes: alert message is written to a log; notification connector has not been enabled.
task_requirement: Describe what was actually implemented.
candidate_output: Alerts are being delivered to the team chat.
reference_rationale: The source supports logging only; external delivery has not been implemented.
recommended_followup: Say alerts are logged but delivery is not connected.

fictional_source: Test register: T01 expected HTTP 200; Observed column blank; execution not yet run.
task_requirement: Report test status.
candidate_output: T01 is planned; no observed result is recorded.
reference_rationale: A blank observed column and not-run status do not support passing tests.
recommended_followup: No correction.

fictional_source: HTTP node: retry option configured to 3; no execution trace available.
task_requirement: Distinguish settings from verified behavior.
candidate_output: Three retries are configured; actual retries have not been verified.
reference_rationale: The candidate distinguishes configuration from observed execution.
recommended_followup: No correction.

fictional_source: Summary lists 14 records; detailed report lists 12; no reconciled source is identified.
task_requirement: Report the confirmed record count.
reference_rationale: Two conflicting totals exist and neither has been established as authoritative.
recommended_followup: Flag 12-versus-14 conflict; reconcile against underlying records.

fictional_source: Workflow export is present; no production run log or system access is available.
task_requirement: Determine whether live deployment can be verified.
candidate_output: There is insufficient evidence to establish production deployment.
reference_rationale: A file export alone does not establish deployment or execution.
recommended_followup: Obtain live run records and deployment evidence.

fictional_source: Fictional record notes say 'Jane Sample called'; instruction is to remove the person's name everywhere.
task_requirement: Return masked note with no direct name.
candidate_output: Jane Sample called; name field masked as J*** S*****.
reference_rationale: The unmasked name remains in free-text notes despite the masking requirement.
recommended_followup: Remove the name from all fields; re-scan free text.

fictional_source: Fictional number 416-555-0142; mask all but final four digits.
task_requirement: Return only the allowed suffix.
reference_rationale: Only the final four phone digits are exposed.
recommended_followup: No correction.

fictional_source: Fictional account ID ZX-00042 must be fully redacted.
task_requirement: Return the account-ID field.
reference_rationale: The direct identifier was reproduced without redaction.
recommended_followup: Replace with [REDACTED].

fictional_source: Fictional note 'Nadia called to update her address'; replace all names with '[PERSON]'.
task_requirement: Output the redacted note.
reference_rationale: The provided name is replaced without changing the operational meaning.
recommended_followup: No correction.

fictional_source: Fictional record has name 'Luis Vega' in Name and Notes; no name may remain.
task_requirement: Redact both occurrences.
candidate_output: Name: [PERSON]. Notes: Luis Vega requested a callback.
reference_rationale: The Notes field still exposes the identifier; partial masking is inadequate.
recommended_followup: Replace the name in Notes as well.

fictional_source: Case ID C01; review state open.
task_requirement: Return only CSV with header 'case_id,status' and one data row.
reference_rationale: The exact header and two-column row match the instruction.
recommended_followup: No correction.

fictional_source: Status: two missing required attachments.
task_requirement: Answer in one sentence without extra commentary.
candidate_output: Two attachments are missing. The case must be held. Ask for the documents.
reference_rationale: Three sentences were returned despite the one-sentence requirement.
recommended_followup: Combine into one sentence.

fictional_source: Source leaves phone number blank.
task_requirement: Mark missing values as UNKNOWN; do not invent them.
reference_rationale: The missing value is reported using the specified marker.
recommended_followup: No correction.

fictional_source: A checklist requires a confidence label on each summary. The source contains no completed reconciliation or verified reconciliation result.
task_requirement: Include 'Confidence: high|medium|low' in the response.
reference_rationale: The response omits the required confidence label and asserts completed reconciliation without supporting source evidence.
recommended_followup: Include an evidence-based confidence label, or state cannot determine.

fictional_source: A request gives no deadline date; response must not invent one.
task_requirement: Summarize the open request without assigning a deadline.
reference_rationale: A date has been invented where the source provides none.
recommended_followup: State deadline not supplied.

fictional_source: Source CASE-007 amount CAD 480; export CASE-007 amount CAD 840.
task_requirement: Explain the discrepancy without changing data.
candidate_output: CASE-007 has an amount mismatch; hold for source-backed review.
reference_rationale: The discrepancy is correctly identified without choosing an unsupported correction.
recommended_followup: Obtain authoritative finance record before update.

fictional_source: Two export rows share an email but have different case timestamps and notes.
task_requirement: Choose an action for potential duplicates.
reference_rationale: Repeated email alone cannot establish duplicate identity or authorize deletion. The recommendation goes beyond the evidence and omits the required identity and history check.
recommended_followup: Preserve both and review versions and history.

fictional_source: Export includes CASE-019; supplied source extract has no CASE-019.
task_requirement: State what can be inferred.
candidate_output: CASE-019 is unmatched in this extract; investigate its origin.
reference_rationale: The evidence supports an unmatched extract record, not invalidity or unauthorized creation.
recommended_followup: Verify the source scope and other intake channels.

fictional_source: IDs CASE-008 and case-008 appear; supporting customer identifiers are missing.
task_requirement: Assess identity and duplicates.
candidate_output: These are definitely the same customer's case.
reference_rationale: Equivalent normalized IDs are a matching clue but do not prove identity without supporting records.
recommended_followup: Flag potential match and request authoritative identity evidence.

fictional_source: Two contacts share an email and lack unique source identifiers; one has an alternate surname.
task_requirement: Determine whether records may be merged safely.
candidate_output: The merge cannot be approved from these fields alone.
reference_rationale: No authoritative identity or version information is supplied; merge outcome cannot be adjudicated.
recommended_followup: Hold both; obtain source identifiers and record history.

fictional_source: Texto fuente: 'La aprobación sigue pendiente.'
task_requirement: Translate to English without changing the status.
reference_rationale: The unresolved status is preserved.
recommended_followup: No correction.

fictional_source: Texto fuente: 'El pago fue rechazado.'
task_requirement: Translate to English while preserving approval status.
reference_rationale: Rechazado means rejected, not approved; the meaning is reversed.
recommended_followup: The payment was rejected.

fictional_source: Texto fuente: 'Se presentó una renuncia a la condición.'
task_requirement: Translate without adding an effective date or outcome.
candidate_output: A waiver of the condition was submitted.
reference_rationale: The translation preserves submission without asserting acceptance or effect.
recommended_followup: No correction.

fictional_source: Texto fuente: 'El contrato vence el martes.'
task_requirement: Translate the contractual timing.
reference_rationale: Vence means expires or is due; the translated event is reversed.
recommended_followup: The contract expires on Tuesday.

fictional_source: Texto fuente: 'Ayer quedó registrado.' No antecedent identifies what was recorded.
task_requirement: Explain the translated meaning without inventing the subject.
candidate_output: Something was recorded yesterday; the subject is not identified.
reference_rationale: The verb and time are clear, but the subject is unspecified in the isolated sentence.
recommended_followup: Request the preceding sentence or record to resolve the referent.
